structured.answer: I wouldn't rely on this site yet. It says itself that it doesn't calculate a long list ("לא מחושב"): structured deposits, foreign-currency and dollar-linked deposits, managers' insurance and savings policies, corporate bonds and Israel Bonds, gold, ETC, the digital currency wallet and turning a pension into a lump sum, and more further down that I didn't reach. The things closest to my deposits are among them, so I'll ask my son or the bank.

stuck.why: Red everywhere made me feel the whole page was dangerous; I nearly backed away
